skills.description: Find and read the Free Agentic Publication Digester's validated daily digest of official US federal publications for a given date, and cite it correctly.
skills.name: fapd-daily-digest

skills.description: Read the in-progress federal publication day from today.json, or a finished day's frozen listing, without mistaking preliminary or backfilled items for the day's news.
skills.name: fapd-live-day

skills.description: Understand which federal sources the digest covers, which are planned or unavailable, and how to read its ingestion statistics.
skills.name: fapd-source-coverage

skills.description: Check a Free Agentic Publication Digester digest against its public repository history and provenance manifests.
skills.name: fapd-verify-the-record
